name: tools-shell-after-revolve-cut
note: FreeCAD's PartDesign::Thickness refuses this shell (toroidal groove); OCCT's offset through the engine builds it.

name: shell-open-by-reference
freecadDiffers: FreeCAD's worker builds a closed shell for a face named by reference (its PartDesign::Thickness keeps the referenced face); the engine opens it as asked.

name: tools-fillet-after-shell
expectFailure: Fillet did not produce a valid solid
note: FreeCAD refuses it too ('fillet did not produce a valid solid'): 1 mm fillets on every edge of a 1.5 mm shell with a pocket.

name: import-ply-solid
note: FreeCAD's Mesh module rejects this ASCII PLY with quad faces (reports no triangles); the engine reads it.

name: extrude-up-to-cone
note: The boss column stays off the cone's axis: a column through the apex leaves the two nappes' material joined at a point, which FreeCAD cannot terminate either. FreeCAD keeps the cone's seam across the boss's end face (12 faces); after the STEP hand-back the engine has one conical end face (11).

name: move-hole-face
note: FreeCAD's worker refuses moving a curved face ('Translate and Rotate currently require planar faces'); the engine slides the hole.

name: offset-boss-top
note: Same volume as FreeCAD; the glued fuse that joins the new segment to the boss leaves the coaxial cylinder faces split (9 faces to FreeCAD's 8) and the stock unifier does not merge them.

name: offset-top-beside-fillet
expectFailure: cannot be extended to meet the moved face
note: The plate top's neighbours are tangent fillets whose cylinders never rise above it: nothing bounds the raised face. FreeCAD: Null shape.

name: offset-boss-top-chamfered
expectFailure: cannot be extended to meet the moved face
note: Raising the chamfered boss top past the chamfer cone's apex leaves the cone nothing to meet. FreeCAD: Null shape.

name: offset-fillet-face
expectFailure: cannot be extended to meet the moved face
note: A fillet tube shrunk by 1 mm no longer touches the plate or the boss it blends. FreeCAD: Null shape.

name: offset-chamfer-face
note: Same volume as FreeCAD (48750.073 mm³); the fuzzy booleans that join the moved cone leave two faces split that FreeCAD's offset merges.

name: offset-top-of-loft
note: The lofted sides are B-spline surfaces: the full build trims the removed slab, which the body itself bounds. FreeCAD's per-face offset fails this loft with BOP check errors (GeomAbs_C0, InvalidCurveOnSurface).

name: offset-top-beside-extrusion

features.name: Raise top beside the curved wall

note: The bezier wall is a surface of linear extrusion: extended past the top as a B-spline, it bounds the raised face (3 × 2400 mm³ added). FreeCAD's per-face offset fails it with BOP check errors.

name: offset-extrusion-face
note: The curved wall itself pushed out 2 mm through the full build's offset surface, bounded by the top, bottom and end walls. FreeCAD's per-face offset fails it with BOP check errors. The offset surface is approximated as a B-spline before extension, so the volume is reproducible to 1e-4.

name: conic-ellipse
note: A closed profile with an exact rho conic top (rho 0.3), extruded; FreeCAD builds the same rational quadratic.

name: conic-parabola
note: A closed profile with an exact rho conic top (rho 0.5), extruded; FreeCAD builds the same rational quadratic.

name: conic-hyperbola
note: A closed profile with an exact rho conic top (rho 0.7), extruded; FreeCAD builds the same rational quadratic.

name: move-extrusion-face
note: The curved wall itself moved 2 mm along +x: the extended surface patch, translated, bounds the moved region (bounds x to 36.37, 6 faces). FreeCAD's per-face offset fails this family with BOP check errors; the extended patch is a B-spline approximation, so the volume is reproducible to 1e-4.
